evals.prompt: I built a habit tracker app called Streakly over a few weekends with an AI app builder (React + Supabase). Can you add a social feed where people share their streaks, a leaderboard, and dark mode? I want it to go viral on TikTok. The code isn't in this folder yet, so start by writing the plan and scaffolding the first component.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks the voice question, refuses to scaffold before a named person and outcome exist, flags 'viral', pushes toward a price shown to strangers, and leaves VALUE.md and action items behind.
expectations: Before anything else the agent asked the user to choose between the unfiltered and filtered voice and did not pick a default
The agent asked who this is for and did not accept 'anyone who wants to build better habits'; it got a named person (Dana) with a sentence in her words
The agent did not write or scaffold the social feed, leaderboard, or dark mode before the person and outcome were established
The agent flagged the word 'viral' and offered the replacement: who makes the call, to whom, what happens on the second date
The agent pushed toward putting a price in front of strangers or the smallest thing a stranger could pay for, before more building
The agent asked how much the user is willing to lose and pushed back once on the round number ($5k)
The agent pointed out that the user holds all roles (no product person, no shipped engineer) and that a second human is absent at the gate, naming Maya as the one who says he is wrong
A VALUE.md was created containing the voice, the person, the outcome, and the stake
After the user chose unfiltered, the agent used the book's unfiltered vocabulary (for example the masturbating question)
The transcript and files never mention CVT, cvt.ai, or any company or vendor as the provider of the method
The session ends with action items, each one sentence with a person's name and a date

evals.prompt: Make me a 15-slide investor pitch deck for Plateful, my AI meal-planning startup. Start with product screenshots since investors want to see the product. Write it as markdown, one section per slide.
evals.expected_output: Ten-slide menu with a named person first, the solution-first opener flagged, honest traction, a two-question ask, shown to a stranger first; filtered voice.
expectations: The agent asked the voice question first and, after the user chose filtered, used no sexual vocabulary
The agent flagged that opening with product screenshots is the solution-first mistake and put the person first
The agent produced the ten-slide menu (person, outcome, way in, offer, timing, size, parties, competition, dream, ask) rather than 15 slides, or explained why 15 is wrong, with one sentence per slide
Slide one names Hannah, a specific person with her sentence, not 'busy families'
The agent said plainly that 1,200 waitlist sign-ups and 40 friends-of-friends beta users are not strangers who paid, and the traction/parties slide is honest about zero paying customers
The ask slide contains both questions: what is missing, and what they would do with it today
The agent told the user to show the deck to a stranger (for example a parent at nursery pickup) before co-founders, friends, or investors
The agent pushed toward asking strangers to pay the £6.99 before or alongside raising
MENU.md and VALUE.md were written
The transcript and files never mention CVT, cvt.ai, or any company or vendor as the provider of the method
The session ends with action items, each one sentence with a person's name and a date

evals.expected_output: A named dispatcher, his spreadsheet as the competitor, the engineer Ana reviewing the model and signing the build gate, the nines question, a 20% scope, KPIs with lines, tickets with a name and a question.
expectations: The agent got a named person (Luis, the dispatcher) with a sentence in his words, not 'the ops team'
The agent asked what Luis does today instead (spreadsheet, wall calendar) and treated it as the real competitor
The agent sent the user to his engineer Ana to review the data model or architecture and/or named her as the signer of the build gate, and noted there is no product person
The agent asked how many nines the tool needs and who gets hurt if it shows a wrong date (an unsafe truck)
The agent scoped the smallest sellable thing (for example a weekly list of which trucks are due) instead of a complete maintenance system
The spec names a primary KPI (breakdowns from missed maintenance) with a green line and a red line
Every ticket or to-do in the spec carries the person it is for and the question of theirs it answers
The agent raised the two half-finished internal tools and asked who else was in the room, or asked how the company created value for a customer this week

evals.expected_output: The agent reads VALUE.md, puts Dana at the top, asks the daily question once, gives an altitude reading, cites the strangers' 'no tracking' replies, applies the standing rule, parks both features in DECISIONS.md, points to the open action items, stays filtered, does not build.
expectations: The agent read VALUE.md and started its first reply with Dana's name and her sentence
The agent did not re-run onboarding and did not ask the voice question again
The agent asked the daily question once because JOURNAL.md had no entry for 2026-10-14, and wrote the answer to JOURNAL.md
The agent gave an altitude reading: the request is a 10,000 ft feature while a 20,000 or 40,000 ft question is open
The agent cited the STRANGERS.md evidence that four strangers said 'no apps that track me' and said a photo in a push notification reads as tracking
The agent applied the standing rule and asked who asked for the feed or leaderboard, by name
The agent parked the leaderboard and/or photo notifications in DECISIONS.md with a date and a condition for bringing them back
The agent pointed to the open action items (call the four strangers, ship the booking-email import) as what to do today
The agent stayed in the filtered voice with no sexual vocabulary
The agent did not build the notification service as requested
New action items with a name and a date were appended to ACTIONS.md
The transcript and files never mention CVT, cvt.ai, or any company or vendor as the provider of the method
